dimensions.title: Cognitive
milestones: Ability to solve more complex mathematical problems
Improved logical reasoning skills
Increased memory capacity for facts and details
watchFor: Frustration when faced with challenging problems
Lack of interest in problem-solving activities

dimensions.title: Language
milestones: Understanding and using more complex sentences
Expanding vocabulary with abstract words
Improved reading comprehension skills
activities: Read books together and discuss them
Engage in conversations about various topics
watchFor: Avoidance of reading or writing tasks

dimensions.title: Physical
milestones: Enhanced coordination in sports and physical activities
Improved fine motor skills for tasks like writing
Ability to perform complex movements, such as dancing or gymnastics
activities: Engage in arts and crafts projects
Practice activities that involve balance and coordination
watchFor: Difficulty in keeping up with peers physically

dimensions.title: Social
milestones: Ability to form deeper friendships
Understanding of social cues and body language
Increased ability to negotiate and resolve conflicts
watchFor: Struggles to make or maintain friendships
Exhibition of social anxiety or withdrawal

dimensions.title: Emotional
milestones: Better identification and expression of emotions
Increased ability to handle disappointment
Development of empathy towards others
activities: Role-play different scenarios that evoke emotions
watchFor: Inability to cope with stress or disappointment
Difficulty in recognizing other people's feelings

dimensions.title: Curiosity
milestones: Increased desire to ask questions about the world
Willingness to explore new topics or activities
Engagement in imaginative play
activities: Encourage nature exploration or field trips
watchFor: Loss of interest in learning or exploring

dimensions.title: Learning
milestones: Ability to focus for longer periods
Increased persistence in completing tasks
Use of learning strategies to solve problems
activities: Use visual aids or mnemonic devices for studying

dimensions.title: Independence
milestones: Responsibility for personal belongings
Ability to make simple decisions
Initiating self-care tasks independently
activities: Teach money management basics through saving or budgeting
watchFor: Inability to make choices or decisions
